1.w: And Abraham was old, advanced in days. And YHWH had blessed Abraham in all things.

2.w: And Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, the one who is ruling over all that is his, “Put, please, your hand under my thigh,

3.w: and I will make you swear by YHWH, the God of the heavens and the God of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite, among whom I am dwelling.

4.w: But to my land and to my kindred you shall go, and you shall take a wife for my son, for Isaac.”

5.w: And the servant said to him, “Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Shall I surely cause your son to return to the land from which you came?”

6.w: And Abraham said to him, “Take heed to yourself that you do not take my son there.

7.w: YHWH, God of the heavens, who took me from the house of my father and from the land of my kindred, and who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, ‘To your seed I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

8.w: And if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this my oath. Only, my son you shall not cause to return there.”

9.w: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his lord, and he swore to him concerning this matter.

10.w: And the servant took ten camels from the camels of his lord, and he went—with all the goods of his lord in his hand—and he arose and went to Aram-naharaim, to the city of Nahor.

11.w: And he made the camels kneel … outside of the city by the well of water at the time of the evening, the time of the coming out of the women who draw water.

12.w: And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, please cause it to happen before me today, and do kindness to my lord Abraham.

13.w: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

14.w: And it shall be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Let down, please, your jar, and I will drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and also I will water your camels,’ she [is the one] You have appointed for Your servant Isaac; and by this I will know that You have done kindness to my lord.”

15.w: And it came to pass, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham, was coming out, and her jar [was] on her shoulder.

16.w: And the young woman [was] very beautiful of appearance, a virgin, and no man had known her; and she went down to the spring and filled her jar and came up.

17.w: And the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me drink a little water from your jar.”

18.w: And she said, “Drink, my lord.” And she hurried and lowered her jar upon her hand and gave him a drink.

19.w: And she finished giving him a drink, and she said, “Also for your camels I will draw until … they have finished drinking.”

20.w: And she hurried, and she emptied her jar into the trough, and she ran again to the well to draw, and she drew for all his camels.

21.w: And the man gazed at her remaining silent, to know whether YHWH had made his way prosperous or not.

22.w: And it came to pass, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden ring, a beka its weight, and two bracelets for her hands, ten [shekels] of gold their weight.

23.w: And he said, “Whose daughter [are] you? Tell me, please. Is there a place in the house of your father for us to lodge?”

24.w: And she said to him, “I [am] the daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

25.w: And she said to him, “Both straw and feed [are] abundant with us, and also a place to lodge.”

26.w: And the man bowed his head and worshiped to YHWH.

27.w: And he said, “Blessed [be] YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, who has not forsaken His kindness and His truth toward my lord; I, being on the way, YHWH has led me to the house of the brother of my lord.”

28.w: And the young woman ran, and told these words to the house of her mother.

29.w: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name [was] Laban; and Laban ran to the man, out to the spring.

30.w: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring and the bracelets on the hands of his sister, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “Thus the man spoke to me,” then he went to the man; and behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

31.w: And he said, “Come in, blessed of YHWH. Why do you stand outside? And I have cleared the house and a place for the camels.”

32.w: And the man came into the house, and he loosened the camels, and he gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who [were] with him.

33.w: And [food] was set before him to eat, and he said, “I will not eat until … I have spoken my words.” And he said, “Speak.”

35.w: And YHWH has blessed my lord greatly, and he has become great; and He has given to him flock and cattle, and silver and gold, and menservants and maidservants, and camels and donkeys.

36.w: And Sarah, wife of my lord, bore a son to my lord after her old age, and he has given to him all that is his.

37.w: And my lord made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite, in whose land I am dwelling.

38.w: But rather, to the house of my father you shall go, and to my kindred, and you shall take a wife for my son.’

39.w: And I said to my lord, ‘Perhaps the woman will not follow me?’

40.w: And he said to me, ‘YHWH, before whom I walk, will send His angel with you and will prosper your way, and you shall take a wife for my son from my kindred and from the house of my father.

41.w: Then you will be clear from my oath—when you come to my kindred; and if they do not give [her] to you, then you will be released from my oath.’

42.w: And I came today to the spring and I said, ‘YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, if now You will prosper the way on which I am going—"

43.w: behold, I am standing by the spring of water, and let it be that the virgin who comes out to draw [water], and I say to her, ‘Give me to drink, please, a little water from your jar,’

44.w: and she says to me, ‘Drink, and I will draw’ for you and also for your camels, she [is] the woman whom YHWH has appointed for the son of my lord.

45.w: And before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah was coming out, and her jar [was] on her shoulder. And she went down to the spring and drew, and I said to her, ‘Give me a drink, please.’

46.w: And she hurried and lowered her jar from herself and said, ‘Drink, and also your camels I will give drink.’ And I drank, and also she gave a drink [to] the camels.

47.w: And I asked her and said, ‘Whose daughter [are] you?’ And she said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ And I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

48.w: And I bowed my head and worshiped to YHWH, and I blessed YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, who led me in the way of truth to take the daughter [of the] brother [of my] lord for his son.

49.w: And now if you⁺ are doing kindness and truth with my lord, tell me; and if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right or to the left.”

50.w: And Laban answered—and Bethuel—and they said, “From YHWH the matter has gone out; we are not able to speak to you evil or good.

51.w: Behold, Rebekah [is] before you; take [her] and go, and let her be wife to the son of your lord, as YHWH has spoken.”

52.w: And it came to pass, when the servant of Abraham heard their words, that bowed himself to the earth before YHWH.

53.w: And the servant brought out articles of silver, and articles of gold, and clothing, and he gave [them] to Rebekah; and precious things he gave to her brother and to her mother.

54.w: And they ate and they drank, he and the men who [were] with him, and they spent the night there. And they arose in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my lord.”

55.w: And her brother said—and her mother—“Let the young woman stay with us [a few] days, or ten [days]. Afterward she may go.”

56.w: And he said to them, “Do not delay me, since YHWH has prospered my way. Send me away so that I may go to my lord.”

57.w: And they said, “Let us call for the young woman and let us ask at her mouth.”

58.w: And they called for Rebekah and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” And she said, “I will go.”

59.w: And they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and the servant of Abraham and his men.

60.w: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “May you, our sister, become the [mother] of thousands of myriads, and may your seed possess the gate of those who hate him.”

61.w: And Rebekah and her young women arose, and they rode on the camels and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah and departed.

62.w: And Isaac had come in from the entrance to Beer-lahai-roi, and he was dwelling in the Negev.

63.w: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening. And he lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, camels [were] coming.

64.w: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and she saw Isaac, and she fell from upon the camel.

65.w: And she said to the servant, “Who [is] this man, the one walking in the field to meet us?” And the servant said, “He is my lord.” And she took the veil and covered herself.

66.w: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

67.w: And Isaac brought her into the tent of Sarah his mother, and he took Rebekah, and she became his wife. And he loved her, and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s [death].
